mentions.name: Next-gen QuickBooks competitor (business accounting software)
mentions.description: A next-generation QuickBooks competitor for business accounting: very cheap (possibly open source) instead of nickel-and-dime pricing, with the extensibility of a modern ERP, a great UI, and support for complex use cases like revenue recognition, expense management, and inventory COGS.
mentions.problem: Existing accounting tools nickel-and-dime users, are expensive, and lack the extensibility needed for complex use cases like revenue recognition, expense management, and inventory COGS.
mentions.audience: Businesses needing accounting software; the author is building it to solve their own business accounting problems and hopes other folks would be interested.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I'm trying to build a next gen quickbooks competitor.

Something that doesn't nickle and dime you, very cheap (perhaps even open source),  has all of the extensibility of a modern ERP, a great UI, and handles complex use cases (revenue rec, expense management, inventory cogs, etc).
